title: Spirit intercedes; we do not know how to pray
english: What then? If things so great become possible by grace, how much more may we dare to speak of prayer — and of how one ought to pray — when [[the Spirit himself intercedes for us with inexpressible groanings >> Bible:Romans 8:26]]? For we do not know what to pray as we ought, yet the Spirit helps our weakness.
translator_notes: GCS 3 Orat.; Pass A≠B; no O'Meara/Greer.

title: Even Paul needs the Spirit to treat prayer
english: And if Paul, who heard [[unutterable words that a human may not speak >> Bible:2 Corinthians 12:4]], still says we do not know how to pray as we ought, who among us will be so bold as to claim the science of prayer without the Spirit? Therefore we ask for grace to treat prayer, as Ambrose and Tatiana asked.
